bagPolicy.summary: The Petersen Events Center enforces a clear bag policy allowing clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags not exceeding 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutch purses. Diaper bags and medically necessary items are exceptions but will be inspected.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags not exceeding 12" x 6" x 12"
prohibited: Food or Beverage (except for special medical needs)
Cans, bottles, glass or other similar containers
Video, audio, professional cameras, recording devices, tripods and bipods
bagPolicy.note: Medically necessary items and diaper bags are exceptions but will be inspected.

parking.note: Parking is available in various lots around the Petersen Events Center, with access directions provided from multiple routes. It is advisable to use the attached map for specific lot locations and access points.

rideshare.note: Drop-off and pick-up for guests attending events at the Petersen Events Center should be made at the main lobby entrance on Terrace Street.

concessions.note: Petersen Events Center offers a variety of food and beverage options through its premier service provider, Chartwells. Guests can enjoy menus from Baseline Grill, Fastbreak, Coaches Corner, and Hardwood Cafe, with additional premium options available in suites.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available on all levels at the Petersen Events Center.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Exiting and re-entering the building with the same ticket is not permitted.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call pick up is available on the day of the event when the box office opens. On site ticket sales are only available when the box office is open.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Petersen Events Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
